info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Strategy Management API
info.description: The Product Strategy Management API enables businesses to refine and update their product strategy based on changing market conditions and internal goals. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can modify existing strategies to better align with their business direction, ensuring ongoing competitiveness. Typical users include product managers and business strategists who rely on accurate and timely updates for informed decision-making. This API supports dynamic adjustments to product offerings, allowing for enhanced responsiveness to customer needs.
